name: input
title: Input
description: A one-line text field: a name, an email, a URL, a search. It is the shared control (`lib/control.ts`), field kind: any focus shows the accent ring. Sizes xs 24 · sm 28 · md 32 · lg 36 (one scale with every control, buttons included) and looks outline · subtle · ghost. Inside a Field (field.json) it is wired to the field's label, helper and error through Ark UI's field context.

anatomy.description: input or textarea No wrapper: the control is the root, so class and style land on this outermost element (what a caller sizes and places); every other attribute stays on the control.

size.description: The shared control's sizes (`lib/control.ts`), dimensions only: xs 24px, sm 28px, md 32px, lg 36px; text 12 · 12 · 13 · 14px; padding 6 · 8 · 10 · 12px. 40px and 16px text on a coarse pointer.

variant.description: The shared control's looks (`lib/control.ts`), at every size. outline: the form field (field colour, hairline). subtle: the inspector (inset grey, no edge). ghost: nothing until touched. Focused, open and invalid look the same in every variant.

invalid.description: aria-invalid and the red ring. Absent: a surrounding Field decides.

keyboard: Standard text editing; Tab moves on
notes: Every field needs a name: a Field label (wired by Ark's field context) or an aria-label.
Inside a Field the control is described by the helper or the error (aria-describedby) and marked aria-invalid; the error should say how to fix the problem.
Text is at least 16px on touch devices so iOS does not zoom the page on focus.
Set type, inputmode, autocomplete and enterkeyhint for the data the field collects.

motion: focus ring and invalid ring: box-shadow over duration.base, ease
hover (pointer only): background over duration.fast, ease
